column3: Mission-start AI init: sets the 4-entry auto-first-aid patient array (525b:0000) to -1, builds the script sequences (ai_build_script_sequences), frees all shot slots (ai_reset_shot_slots) and all noise-event slots (FUN_1000_841a)
Marks all 32 shot/impact records at 53ba:28ba (stride 0x3c, byte +0 = free flag) as free

Builds the three built-in member script sequences at 53ba:268c (0 = stand/turn 180/run after 0xff00, 1 = stop/kneel, 2 = stop/prone), far-allocating the 0x1a-byte step nodes; calls exit() if an allocation fails
Frees the far-heap script step nodes allocated by ai_build_script_sequences
(unreferenced, apparently buggy) Marks the group script active (gai+0x7e) and copies script idx's first step into the node pointed to by gai+0x14, setting its delay
Starts script sequence idx on a member: mind flags |= 0x40, mind+0x70 = &script[idx], mind+0x6e = script[idx].delay
Clears a member's AI mind (command ring, 3 contact slots, group link, flags, script state, suppression timer)
Clears a group's AI block (destination, timers, waypoint pointers (without freeing), counters, order type/behaviour; direction flag = 1)
Initialises a group's AI block from its 0x66-byte mission record: behaviour, staggered think delay, order type, patrol waypoints (order 1) or random deployment delay (order 3)
Resets a new member's mind, links it to its group and sets the active flag 0x80 unless the group is a delayed reinforcement (order 3)
Counts entries of a null-terminated array of far pointers (group member list / group table)
Returns the command the member should execute now: its own newest command if pending, else the group's newest pending command (unless member suppressed), else NULL
Returns the member's newest own command slot (even if already consumed), or NULL while suppressed (flag 0x10)
Clears the group-level and every member's "command pending" flags after the executor has run them
Copies a 12-byte position into the group AI destination (gai+0x00)
Returns the index of the first enemy group (from g_first_enemy_group) of kind 4/5 whose leader is not yet active (no 0x80), or -1
True if the group leader is within 150 (running) or 30 (otherwise) units of the group destination
True if (leader alerted and behaviour != 0x20 guard) or order type is 1 (patrol) or 3 (pursue/reinforce)
Chooses the group's next destination: midpoint to best contact when alerted, guard/objective patrol square or random offset when contacts are lost, else next ping-pong patrol waypoint
Reaction-delay table lookup; the search loop has no compare so it always returns the low byte of B[n] (quirk)
Pushes a 0x14-byte command (passed by value) into a member mind's 5-slot ring and sets the pending flag
Pushes a command into the ring of every group member except the player and members running a script (flag 0x40)
Clears the pending-command flag of non-player, non-scripted members; clears the group pending flag unless a group script is active

Deploys a reserve group: teleports the leader to a given position (or 720..1200 units from the player), re-forms it, gives it a 3-point patrol 120..600 units around the target, alerts it and activates all members (flags 0x81), behaviour 0x10
(unreferenced) If not in alarm mode, runs ai_group_reinforcement_tick for every enemy group
For a not-yet-active group: counts down its deployment timer (gai+0x0c) by dt and deploys it near the player when it expires; returns 1 if the group must be skipped this tick
(unreferenced) Broadcasts a turn command to heading leader_heading +/-110 degrees (dir 1 = +)
SEAL squad: every member carrying first-aid items treats the most seriously wounded teammate (wound level >= 2) not already recorded in the 525b:0000 patient array
(unreferenced) Sets gai+0x7f if any member has unit flag +0x26 bit0; when it clears again broadcasts a stop command
Advances group/member script sequences by dt; issues the next step's command when its delay expires; returns 1 if a script consumed this group's tick
Main AI tick (called from the game loop with elapsed ticks): for every group runs perception, alert/noise handling, reaction timers, movement orders and combat
Clears the alerted flag (0x01) of every non-player member of a group
Sets the alerted flag (0x01) on every non-player member and zeroes the group think timer (unless gai+0x7f)
Clears the active flag 0x80 of a member's mind (called when the member dies); ignores the player
Adjusts the group sighting range by the leader's attribute byte (+6 block, +0x06): >=60 adds (v-15)*3, <=45 adds (v-55)*3
Empty stub called during sighting-range computation
Adds 60 to the sighting range if the target's attribute byte (+6 block, +0x08) > 75, and another 300 if > 90
Sets the sighting range to 135 if the target is prone (posture 2) and the observer is not already engaging
Rotates an angle by +90/-90/+180 for member index 1/2/3 when group mode is 0, 2 or 3 (result unused by its only caller)
Drops contacts whose target is dead, surrendered, suppressed (mode-4 groups) or has moved more than 150 units from the last seen position
Writes a contact slot (position, target member/object, distance, score, obstruction) and sets mind flag 0x08
True if any of the mind's 3 contact slots already references the given target member
Returns the highest score byte among the mind's in-use contacts (0 if none)

Group perception: expires contacts, then every member looks for hostile units within sighting range, outside the rear blind spot and with low obstruction; records contacts, alerts/engages the group; returns true if the group has contacts
True if any of the mind's 3 contact slots is in use
Writes the index of the highest-scoring in-use contact whose target is alive (or flagged) to *out, -1 if none
Copies the best contact of the first groupmate that has one into this mind's slot 0 (score 25); returns 0, or -1 if no groupmate has a contact
Returns a mask of weapons able to reach a distance: bit0 primary (range >= d), bit1 secondary (range >= 4*d)
Returns the 3D object of the enemy group leader (kind != 6) nearest to a position, or NULL
Fire control for support groups (kinds 1-3): members near their aim point pick a contact (or 50% chance an area target at the aim point) and issue reload or fire commands
Combat behaviour per member: surrender/flee/take-cover rolls for enemy soldiers, turn to target, weapon choice, jam clearing, reload, fire; delegates support groups to ai_group_support_fire
Counts down each member's suppression timer (mind+0xce) by dt and clears flag 0x10 when it reaches 0
